items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: But she got me a job in Elizabeth, New Jersey, and that’s where he was born, Jackie was born, my son.

ctx.x: And how old were you then?

I would say twenty. So we got married there in Ithaca, and I forgot where we went from Ithaca. We came back home. She went to her house, which was in Taberg on a farm, and I went to my house, and then I finally told my mother and she finally told her family. So then I got a job in Saranac Lake quickly so that we didn’t have to stay at our homes or get a household together. So we went to Saranac Lake and I played there at the Overlook Inn, oh for about a year. So then a girl singer, Jerry Kruger, she got…
So when you say you were rehearsing with the acts—
